package.name: l5_tracking_demo
package.description: ENPM818Z Lecture 5 hands-on, Tracking section: a multi-object tracker with one constant-velocity Kalman filter per object, gating with the NIS, GNN or NN association and the track lifecycle (tentative, confirmed, coasting, deleted). Detections come from the L2 bridge's LiDAR, by clustering, or from CARLA's ground truth with noise, misses, clutter and class flips added. An evaluator grades both against CARLA's truth.
